images.name: 余烬·裂疆
images.design: A massive asymmetrical crimson scarlet executioner's greatsword: blade has one straight cutting side and one very broad stepped outward shoulder on the opposing side, one long offset angular void cut completely through the upper blade. Three large offset trapezoid blade segments interlock along an uninterrupted central load-bearing spine, with small dark gaps, culminating in a sharply oblique guillotine tip. Heavy thick planar slabs with red bevels, deep ruby interiors, a small rose-red edge accent. Guard is an asymmetric pair of short slanted plates, lower pommel a split trapezoidal wedge. Four or five red ember rectangles drift from the blade's stepped back. Brutal architectural silhouette; no giant axe head and no conventional symmetrical crossguard.

images.name: 流萤·双岚
images.design: An elegant gigantic jade mint-teal bifurcated greatsword: two unequal wide flowing angular cutting rails separate ABOVE the guard, curve gently outward around a long open crescent-shaped negative space, then sweep back toward each other near the top WITHOUT touching; the longer rail has a spear-sharp tip while the shorter inner rail ends well below it, creating an unmistakable forked asymmetric blade. The curved rails are broad faceted ribbon-blades, not thin wires or bow limbs, with three deliberate origami-like folds, rich emerald faces and luminous turquoise edges. Guard is one sweeping angular hook counterbalanced by a short flat fin; two-hand straight grip with a hollow diamond pommel. Small sparse mint triangular motes stream gently along the opening. Distinctive slender sweeping sword silhouette, no string, no arrow, no staff.

images.name: 寒汐·错界
images.design: A giant cool-blue architectural greatsword built from three broad hollow rectangular monolith sections that are laterally offset, interlocking around a single straight inner blade spine. The total outline stays a tall sword: squared shoulder, broad parallel middle, decisive sharp wedge-shaped spear tip. Each rectangular negative-space window is long and narrow with thick slab sides; sections alternate their side offset and depth, with visible rigid connecting bridges, creating a brutalist stepped silhouette rather than chains or floating thin frames. Rich cobalt to cyan planes, clean bright cyan bevels, dark hollow windows. Guard a low wide offset rectangular bracket, straight two-hand grip, compact square frame pommel. Only a few blue short linear particle fragments suspended parallel to the blade. Heavy dimensional substantial weapon, no gun, no gears, no metallic texture.

images.name: 梦隙·悬劫
images.design: A regal purple suspended-fragment greatsword: five LARGE disconnected sharpened blade slabs float in precise alignment over the hilt to form one long asymmetric tapered cutting silhouette, separated by clearly visible modest dark gaps. Slabs are skewed kite and parallelogram shapes, largest near lower blade, narrowing toward a very long diamond spear tip. A fine contained violet energy filament connects the aligned cores; offset small shard outriggers appear only on one side, no explosion of tiny fragments. Broad plum and blue-violet solid energy faces with lavender bevel lines, graceful negative space. Guard comprises two unequal angular fins cradling a small levitating lozenge above a practical straight two-hand grip, short pointed diamond pommel. A few violet geometric chips orbit locally near gaps, narrow restrained purple light. No conventional steel blade hidden under shards, no crown icon, no crystalline stone texture.
